items.title: continue、continue on 与 proceed 的语域差异
items.explanation: continue 最通用，可表示继续动作或状态；continue on 强调沿当前路线或方向继续；proceed 更正式，常见于交通指示、公告和流程说明。
items.example: When the light turns green, proceed through the intersection carefully.

items.title: 交通语境中的 may proceed
items.explanation: 说明交通信号给予通行许可时，may proceed 比 can continue on 更精确，并隐含确认道路安全后再通行。
items.source: A green light on a traffic signal means your car can continue on
items.example: When the light turns green, you may proceed if the intersection is clear.
